readings.moment: At nine, when the temple struck (the master had everyone show their watches)
The hall clock downstairs struck ten, while Lina was working in the atelier
At the moment the hall clock struck ten, the regulator showed twelve minutes to ten
When the temple struck ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly
When the master sent Lina downstairs
When the piano began (Madame began to play), with Lina in the kitchen
When the piano stopped, with Lina in the kitchen
The temple struck eleven, while Lina was still in the kitchen with Rosa

durations: 13 minutes between the piano starting (10:58) and the piano stopping (11:11)
whereabouts: After dinner, Lina went up to the atelier.
In the atelier, Lina worked beside the master at his bench.
The master was in the atelier at his bench with Lina during the evening.
When the regulator showed 10:20, the master sent Lina downstairs.
After being sent down at 10:20, Lina went straight to the kitchen.
When the piano began, Lina was in the kitchen with Rosa.
When the piano stopped, Lina was in the kitchen with Rosa.
Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
That afternoon, Lina saw the master in the kitchen holding Rosa's American alarm clock.
